title: The Knight Goes Twice
setup: Black's king has just fled the diagonal into the corner, and the bishop on b4 covers f8 from afar.
hint: Count the escapes: f8 is covered and the pawns hold g7 and h7, so the king can only shuttle between two squares.
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Nf7+}} drives the king out, {{Kg8}} forced, and {{Nh6+}} comes back as a double check, so {{Kh8}} is again the only move. Now the knight guards g8: {{Qg8+}} {{Rxg8}} and {{Nf7#}}. This is Philidor's Legacy, and the two knight jumps exist only to prepare the sacrifice.
